_comment: kb-cef-graft config file - agents change the environment configuration here, not the script itself. Copy to kb-cef-graft.config.json, edit the values, then: python kb-cef-graft.py --config <path> --template <Qt template> --qt-sdk <SDK> --ohqtcef-glue <OpenQtCef> --output <out> --run
_cli_overrides: The --deveco/--device/--ohos-ndk CLI arguments override the corresponding entries in this file
_sdk_note: OpenQtCef web_engine uses lazy import, which needs API17; when switching OpenQtCef versions, follow the compatibleSdkVersion in its build-profile
_qt_libs_note: Qt5 uses libQt5*; for Qt6 change to ["libQt6Core.so","libQt6Gui.so","libQt6Widgets.so"]
